title: Numeric remaining days and a frozen baseline on each task
goal: Task effort gains machine-readable `days` (remaining focused days) and `baselineDays` (the first accepted estimate, never rewritten), alongside the existing words
acceptance: `effort.days` and `effort.baselineDays`: optional non-negative numbers in quarter days, at most 20; the free-text estimate stays
`baselineDays` is set once when a step is first planned and kept when the step closes; closing sets `days` to 0
Existing tasks without the numbers stay valid; check:backlog warns once per open task without `days` when featurePlans is on
BACKLOG-RULES: the baseline is the accepted estimate, revisions change `days` only (supersedes "never reconstruct an unmeasured original estimate" only for steps planned after adoption)
privacy: Metadata only: estimates, dates, durations and task identities; no prompts, transcripts or personal data.
validation: tools/test-tools.mjs fixtures: valid and invalid numbers, missing numbers, a closed step keeping its baseline

effort.basis: Released in v5.3.0 after PR #113 (CI 43068637718) and review-fix PR #114 (CI 43069622289) with independent review; baseline 1 focused day(s). No actual recorded: the three features were built together in one session, so a per-step figure would be invented.

escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner (BACKLOG-RULES, "Optional upfront feature plans")
